item.tib: gtad pa las kyi gzer bu
item.coloph: dbal mo las thigs (thig) srog gi ser ni skya brag seng ge 'phyong 'dra'i phyas na yod do/ las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog dun tse nyams pa'i lags (lag) du ma btang (gtong) bar/ srid pa'i rgyal mos las chen po la sprod pa 'di gtong cig des kyang srog la ma 'bab bar du sku rgyud lo(do/)bdag 'dra dran pa nam mkha'i (mkhas/)phyi rab (rabs) gshen po'i don du sbas/ nan bon btsun pa rnams kyis rnam smin ban btsun khyod la sdig bon rnams chos su bsgyar ba'i rnam smin khyod la sdig rnams (rnam) smin ban btsun khyer la shog sku rgyud smar ro/ sbas rgya'o/ 'di shog se+er dmar smug zhing sor bzhi ba dkyus mda' tshad 'dug pa la 'phrin rgya dang gsum gda'o//
